title: Land use and land cover changes and ecosystem services value in Qianyang County, China
keywords: land use and land cover changes
core_idea: Analyze how land use and land cover (LULC) changes influence ecosystem services value (ESV) in Qianyang County by using 2007–2022 30 m LULC data, mapping spatial distribution and clustering of ESV with spatial statistical methods, and simulating 2050 LULC scenarios with the PLUS model to explore driving forces.
tldr: The study aims to assess impacts of LULC changes on ESV in Qianyang County using high-resolution historical LULC data, spatial statistics, and PLUS-model future scenarios to inform sustainable land management.
